Name: Leah Gives You Clay Pot
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][i][color=#fff2cc]Ever wanted to plant a fancy flower inside your farmhouse but don't want to cheat? Ever found an ancient seed on day 3 but had completely no clue where to safely plant it on your farm? Then this mod is for you!
[/color][/i][size=2](About the Ancient Fruits... yes, you can't plant them in pots in vanilla game, but you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21603/]this tweak I've made[/url]﻿﻿ to allow that!)[/size][/center][center][size=2]-------------------------[/size][/center][size=2]
[/size][center][size=2]This mod adds a little questline for Leah - upon reaching 3 hearts with her, she will ask you a favor to help with her new art project. After helping her, she will send you a letter with one Garden Pot attached. 
The questline contains 2 new events, to trigger it - reach 2 hearts friendship with Leah and enter the Forest map.

[/size][/center][center][size=2]This mod is compatible with pretty much anything since it doesn't add anything new into the game.[/size][/center][size=2]
[/size][center][size=2]---------------------------[/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: Changed event trigger condition - now you need 3 hearts (instead of 2) with Leah to trigger the event

Manifest.Description: Ever wanted a single clay pot from the start but doesn't want to cheat? Leah now will give you one if you help her with something.
